notes: All four documents (bank statement, invoice, ledger entry, receipt) share consistent vendor name (GreenRoute Logistics Pvt. Ltd.), currency (INR), and total amount (59,000), and follow a plausible date sequence (receipt 2026-07-18, invoice 2026-07-21, payment/ledger 2026-08-18). However, this internal consistency does not establish that the referenced PO-1005 exists or was ever issued - the PO document itself is absent, and both the invoice and receipt cite it as a reference, so its absence is treated as missing supporting evidence rather than assumed exemption. The successful bank settlement (BNK-1005) and matching ledger debit (LED-1005) confirm payment occurred but do not independently corroborate that a purchase order or that payment terms tied to the PO were satisfied. Tax amount is broken out only on INV-1005 (9,000 of 59,000); other documents state combined totals without a separate tax line, which is a documentation limitation rather than an inconsistency. Given the confirmed but unverified PO reference, confidence is moderate rather than high.
